archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Academic Indigo

rules: Ensure body text has leading-relaxed for long-form reading (exam questions).
Avoid centering text heavily; use left alignment for reading clarity.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid with 10% opacity in dark mode, crisp in light mode. Subtle borders everywhere instead of heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards. Focus on flat, modern aesthetics with subtle depth.
visual_enhancers.animations: Restrained and smooth. Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions on buttons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on sticky headers and floating navs (backdrop-blur-xl with semi-transparent background).

components.sidebar: Collapsible 250-280px on desktop. Must use a polished, minimal style (no excessive colors). Active state should use the subtle indigo accent.
components.chat_interface: Spacious. AI messages visually distinct from user messages. Minimalist input area with attachment buttons.
components.exam_simulator: Data-dense but clean. Sidebar for question palette (Not Visited, Not Answered, Answered, Marked for Review). Top bar for timer and auto-submit.
components.daily_20: Focused card-based question view with clear navigation.

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid or Flexbox with a fixed sidebar and scrollable main content area.
layouts.chat: Flex column, grow the message list, sticky input area at the bottom.
layouts.exam: CSS Grid. 3-column layout on desktop: Left (Main Content/Question), Right (Question Palette & Timer).

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight vertical slide (translate-y-2 to 0).
motion.micro_interactions: Scale buttons to 0.98 on click. Hover states on cards elevate slightly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Important for exam reading.
accessibility.keyboard: All exam options must be selectable via keyboard (A, B, C, D). Chat must submit on Enter (Shift+Enter for new line).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (indigo-500) on all interactive elements.

images.description: Professional student avatar for user profile and chat bubbles.
Math equation on chalkboard to demonstrate image upload feature in the chat.

media.icons: lucide-react (already installed). Use standard icons: spark/bot for AI, user for profile, layout for dashboard, book-open for exams.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Create and update all files with .js or .jsx extensions only, not .tsx. You have .js files not .tsx.
Build a unified App Shell with a collapsible sidebar and mobile drawer using Shadcn components.
Implement the Chat Interface as the primary route (/). It should include an empty state, message history, typing indicator, and a complex input area with a 'stop generation' button.

Implement the Exam Simulator with a realistic UI: Question text, multiple-choice options, and a side panel showing the status of all questions (Palette) with standard JEE colors (e.g., Red for unanswered, Green for answered, Purple for review).
Implement the Daily 20 view with a streamlined, distraction-free card layout.
Ensure Math/Equation rendering is prepared (you can mock the CSS for math if not installing a library, but the UI must look math-ready).
No real AI backend. Mock the chat responses with a setTimeout.
Persist chat history in MongoDB using the FastAPI backend.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on headers; always use backdrop-blur or solid colors.
Tailwind v4 is used, so global theme overrides go in index.css inside @theme. Do not create tailwind.config.js.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined blue/indigo academic theme and maintain the clean, premium feel.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid excessive gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects (backdrop-blur-xl) on sticky headers and modals.
NEVER apply a universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
NEVER center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep text naturally flowing left-to-right.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded, not overly pill-shaped for an academic tool) with interaction animations.
Do NOT use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡). Use sleek Lucide icons instead.
Ensure every interaction has a micro-animation (hover, click).
Use generous spacing (p-6 to p-8) for readability.
Missing categories of images should not default to placeholders. Only use provided URLs.
